summary: Macro sentiment is mixed: equities remain resilient near record highs and oil has pulled back below $100, while elevated Treasury yields and renewed Fed-hike expectations pressure risk assets and gold. Crypto-specific coverage is limited in the available results; Bitcoin has relative support, but Michaël van de Poppe expects a short-term altcoin correction before a stronger fourth quarter.
